goal: acceptance gate: memory, VRAM, caches and the archive queue inside the budgets declared in 2026-09-10, with no drift across repeated missions
source_of_measurements: the three consecutive rated full-area runs of 2026-09-12 and the 11 kHz bench of 2026-09-13

totals.host_rss_verdict: within for the rated mission length, 19.53 to 19.75 GiB, a margin of 1.3 to 2.4 percent -- but see amended_2026_09_14: the budget is exceeded by any mission longer than about fifteen minutes
totals.device_verdict: within, 9.72 to 9.78 GiB whole device including an 899 MiB desktop baseline, a margin of 2.2 to 2.8 percent
totals.drift: none: peak RSS 19.66 / 19.75 / 19.53 GiB and peak device 9.78 / 9.72 / 9.78 GiB across three consecutive missions

runtime recipe source material.verdict: no line in the declared budget

tile_cache.finding: the 1177.8 MiB reported as device_payload_bytes reads as a threefold overrun of the 385.5 MiB tile cache line, and is not one. MaterialCache::Bytes() sums the slots, the tile index and the runtime recipe. The slots come to 385.5 MiB, exactly the budget, because the texture formats are the budgeted ones -- one byte of colour and two of normal per texel. The remaining 830,779,460 bytes are the recipe's own source material, which matches results/full_road_compact_pixels.json byte for byte and which the budget table has no line for.
tile_cache.consequence: a budget omission rather than a breach. The declared table needs a runtime-recipe line of 792.3 MiB; the total device figure was already within its own budget with that memory included.

queues.archive_shutdown: every task of 2026-09-13 recorded drained true with zero write errors
queues.verdict: queues never approached their capacity and nothing was dropped

findings: host memory and whole-device VRAM are inside their declared budgets on every one of three consecutive full-area missions, with margins of about two percent
nothing drifts across repeats: the three peaks agree to within 0.2 GiB of host memory and 0.06 GiB of device memory
the tile cache is exactly on its 385.5 MiB budget; what looked like a threefold overrun is 792.3 MiB of runtime recipe source that the budget table never listed
the acceptance margins are thin, about 2 percent on both totals, so the missing recipe line matters for any future growth even though nothing is over today
not_covered: the declared table also reserves 512 MiB for camera, queues and robot and 3 GiB for driver, window and GZ overhead; those were reserved for long-run measurement and are still not separately attributed
whole-device VRAM cannot be attributed per process here, so the desktop baseline of 899 MiB is inside the measured figure
disk: the 164.82 GB figure budgets three captures plus a full rescan, which this workspace has not run in one sitting

amended_2026_09_14.what_changed: the conclusion below is scoped to the twelve-minute rated missions it was measured on, and does not survive longer ones
amended_2026_09_14.reading: process tree RSS grows with mission duration at roughly 10 to 16 MiB per second and crosses the 20 GiB budget after about fifteen minutes. The three rated runs came in under budget because they are 12.7 minutes long, not because the budget is respected. The 0.5 m/s full-area run reached 30.07 GiB on a 31 GiB host and the mission faulted.
